name: RDB Rasayans Limited
about: RDB Rasayans Limited manufactures and sells polymer-based woven bags and flexible intermediate bulk container jumbo bags in India. The company operates through Manufacturing Activity and Trading segments. The company offers woven sacks, specialized texturized fabrics, polyethylene (PE) liners, and bulk container liners. It also provides customized jumbo bags, including baffle, circular, and U-panel configurations. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Kolkata, India.
